reviewer: Codex, personal complete-final-answer read; no paid judge
primary_route: Direct GSDMD N-terminal membrane action tested by purified protein/defined lipid reconstitution, orthogonal physical permeability and qualified mutant cellular rescue; conditional indirect-effector branch.

checks.reason: No explicit pre-execution consultation of original Methods, supplements or validated protein/membrane/cell protocols to select and verify transferable conditions. Naming unknown settings and proposing local validation does not meet this separate lookup requirement.

checks.quote: should be established by pilot titration
checks.reason: Critical buffer, timing, dose and cellular settings are deferred without operational calibration-to-choice rules.

No independent free-reporter/protein interference and reference-recovery/acceptance gate with a defined calibration failure action. Orthogonal assays alone do not calibrate the primary fluorescence signal.
No operational independent-preparation/culture replication plan tied to a meaningful-effect or precision/power objective and pilot variance.
No prospective randomized/balanced processing, allocation concealment or blinded acquisition/analysis, or justified equivalent.
No prospective technical exclusion, attrition, all-field/trace inclusion and stopping policy preserving biological nonresponses.
No selected primary contrast/time window, statistical model, uncertainty construction and multiplicity procedure.

checks.quote: a matrix of neutral, mildly anionic, strongly anionic
checks.reason: Qualitative classes are specified, but no bounded quantitative lipid/protein range or objective derivation, criterion and lock.
No explicit revised-procedure refreeze and fresh independent confirmation after failed or ambiguous exploratory work.
No complete construct/protein/lipid/culture-to-raw-acquisition manifest, analysis versions/settings and exclusion provenance.

historical_match_reason: All five components match the direct route. Question: "sufficient by itself to permeabilize a defined lipid bilayer". Mechanism and intervention: active/full-length/CT states, lipid variation and "Mutations that preserve folding but impair membrane binding", with expression/stability/cleavage checks. Readout: binding/oligomerization, leakage/conductance/lesion imaging and GSDMD-deficient cellular reconstitution. Outcome: "Mutants defective in reconstitution activity are also defective in cellular lysis" while upstream activation/processing remain intact. First-round Hit@1 retained; no required historical residues or settings invented.
